title: Total Distance Traveled
statement:
A truck burns fuel only from its main tank, which starts with `mainTank` liters, and drives 10 km on each liter. A spare tank starts with `additionalTank` liters. Every time another 5 liters have been burned from the main tank, 1 liter moves from the spare tank into the main tank at that instant, as long as the spare tank still holds fuel; nothing is transferred between those 5-liter marks.

Return the largest number of kilometers the truck can drive.
notes:
## Intuition

Only whole 5-liter blocks matter: each block burned from the main tank is 50 km and may pull one liter from the spare tank, which can itself help complete the next block. Simulating block by block keeps everything in whole liters and is at most about 25 steps. (A liter-by-liter simulation also works and is what the brute force does.)

## Approach

1. Start with `distance = 0`.
2. While the main tank holds at least 5 liters, burn a block: take 5 liters away and add 50 km.
3. After the block, if the spare tank is not empty, move one liter from `additionalTank` into `mainTank`.
4. When fewer than 5 liters remain, no more transfers can happen; burn them all for `mainTank * 10` km more.

## Example 1, step by step

`mainTank = 5`, `additionalTank = 10`. The loop runs once: `mainTank` drops to 0, `distance` becomes 50, and one liter is transferred, so `mainTank = 1` and `additionalTank = 9`. Now `1 < 5`, the loop stops, and the result is `50 + 1 * 10 = 60`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(mainTank): each pass removes a net of at least 4 liters.
- Space: O(1).

## Pitfalls

- Do not add `additionalTank / 5` or any fraction: transfers happen only at whole 5-liter marks, so stay with integers.
- The transferred liter counts toward the next 5-liter block, so a single pass that ignores it undercounts (`mainTank = 9` with plenty of spare fuel gives 110 km, not 100).
- Stop transferring once the spare tank is empty.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `mainTank` | liters left in the main tank |
| `additionalTank` | liters left in the spare tank |
| `distance` | kilometers driven by the full 5-liter blocks so far |

narration.2: No distance has been covered yet.
narration.4: Keep going while a whole 5-liter block can still be burned.
narration.5: Burn the 5 liters from the main tank.
narration.6: Those 5 liters carry the truck 50 km.
narration.7: A transfer happens only if the spare tank still has fuel.
narration.8: Take one liter out of the spare tank...
narration.9: ...and put it into the main tank.
narration.12: Burn the last few liters, which are too few to trigger another transfer.
